summary: The candidate is correct and complete. The metronoid scaling argument proves the required decreasing-mass inclusion, the accepted 6/5 nesting applies because every selected weight is positive and at most a_y/4, and each D_y is an origin-symmetric convex body whose gauge is finite on all of R^d and has the stated closed-ball characterization. The affine hull of every nonempty integer subset is a primitive affine lattice subspace, so the selector fact applies even when the selected set spans a proper subspace; the empty selected-set case is correctly handled by capacity nonnegativity. The positive-part estimate passes correctly to the possibly unattained infimum, the proper-rank and full-rank capacities are normalized consistently, and both strict numerical conclusions follow with constants 39/8000 and 39/55.
